authorizationText: La idea es que configures tú lo más que puedas sin depender de mí; auditoría de Cloud Shell para proyecto Classroom MCP y GitHub Actions provista para continuar.
reason: The first authenticated read-only GCP IAM audit successfully verified WIF but a bash double-quoted echo with Markdown backticks accidentally invoked shell substitutions and erased the actual service and secret names. Fix output escaping to preserve factual names and append non-sensitive IAM/project metadata to job logs for inspection without asking the user for another screenshot. Keep every audit command read-only and no secret values logged. Add regression preventing shell backtick substitution.
